investigations.question: What kills the pilot 7x at x~2855-2983 (dominant cluster x~2941) and what does each death cost in replay seconds? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input history, no hazard-phase data, and no gameplay frames; a mistimed encounter, an unfair hotspot, and a policy defect are all live.
